defects.KeysForTag aliases index: KeysForTag appends the parent tag's keys onto the index's own slice, so the returned slice shares the index's backing array; a caller's append or a later Set on that tag then overwrites entries the other side holds.
defects.restore empty nils maps: Restore with an empty snapshot sets entries and tags to nil, so the next Set writes to a nil map and panics.
defects.Len value receiver: Len has a value receiver, so the RLock is taken on a copy of the mutex and the live map is read without synchronization.
defects.restore shadowed err: In Restore the loop's err shadows the named result, so the break after a failed load returns a nil error and a partial load is reported as success.
defects.budget int32 overflow: The budget is computed in int32, so max_memory_mb of 2048 or more wraps to a negative MaxBytes and every Set evicts everything, including the entry just stored.
defects.warm leaks workers: The results channel became unbuffered while Warm now returns on the first error, so workers still sending results block forever and leak.

decoys.decoy loop capture: The goroutines in WarmTenants capture the loop variable keys by reference, so every goroutine warms the last tenant's keys.
decoys.decoy Get expiry rewrite: Rewriting the expiry test in Get as expires.Compare(now) <= 0 returns entries that expired exactly at now, because the comparison is inclusive where the old Before test was exclusive.
decoys.decoy reordered used bytes: Moving the c.used update in Set below the tag loop lets eviction run before the byte count includes the new value, so Set can leave the cache over budget.
decoys.decoy delete presence check: Guarding Delete with an existence check before removeLocked changes behavior for missing keys, because the check skips index cleanup that removeLocked would have done.
